chapter: A musical family and the old New Orleans bands
title: Chester Zardis and the Marrero family of bassists and banjoists
summary: Danny describes Chester Zardis and the four Marrero sons, with Simon and John as masters.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, the reason(?) when you say about bass... See, I know about Chester...

Little short Chester here. But Simon Marrero was considered the boss. But his Daddy had been the greatest, you know, Rag to Jazz bass before him -- Billy Marrero. That's what they called him. Old Man Billy Marrero. Simon Marrero, John Marrero, Lawrence Marrero and Eddie... Four brothers. Two banjo players and two bass players. And that was Old Man Billy Marrero's sons.
